from hpack import Encoder
import struct

def frame(t, flags, sid, payload=b''):
    return len(payload).to_bytes(3,'big') + bytes([t, flags]) + (sid & 0x7fffffff).to_bytes(4,'big') + payload
enc=Encoder()
headers=[(':method','POST'),(':scheme','http'),(':authority','example.com'),(':path','/reproxy-test')]
hb=enc.encode(headers)
print('hb', hb.hex(), len(hb))
data=b'PRI * HTTP/2.0\r\n\r\nSM\r\n\r\n'
data += frame(4,0,0,b'')
data += frame(1,4,1,hb)
data += frame(0,0,1,b'a')
data += frame(0,1,1,b'b')
data += frame(0,0,1,b'c')
open('/workspace/poc1','wb').write(data)
print(len(data))
